modifier.tinkersnewlife.anti_gravity.des: Forward (technique key C): all creatures within the radius (scaled by curse output & affinity), except the caster, are levitated; each target costs one unit of curse power. Reversal (F): deploy a pressure field - targets resist by body size & max HP (slowness below threshold, crushed blocks / stun / sustained damage above it). Costs curse power per second. Uses a technique slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.anti_gravity.drai: §cOut of curse power - pressure field collapsed
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.flavo: Divide into ten; one strike to the heart.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.descr: Forward (technique key C, requires line of sight): divide the target into ten equal parts and summon a golden weak-point orb at the seventh mark (70% height, in front of the target, follows it, lasts 20s). Hitting that orb with any of your damage triggers a crit on the target - damage x crit multiplier (1.3 + output x0.08 + affinity x0.004); the orb shatters after one hit. Pressing C again on a marked target performs a guaranteed precise slash. Uses a technique slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.ten_divide.marked: §6Weak point carved on %s: strike the golden orb to crit once
modifier.tinkersnewlife.mixu_gelong.flav: Wrapped in a cocoon, still as a mountain.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.mixu_gelong.desc: New Shadow Style - Mikoshi Kago (skill, uses a skill slot): passively activates while trapped in an enemy domain - you are frozen (no techniques, no items, no movement) in exchange for absolute defense against domain effects (including Unlimited Void's stun). Costs 24 curse power/sec; ends when drained.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.luohua.flavor: Blossoms on the wind, body like a dance.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.luohua.descripti: New Shadow Style - Falling Blossom (skill, uses a skill slot): passively activates while trapped in an enemy domain - you may act freely (techniques & items usable, but slow movement) and resist domain effects, but cannot resist Unlimited Void's stun. Costs 24 curse power/sec.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jianyi_lingyu.fl: A small world of your own that turns force aside.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jianyi_lingyu.de: New Shadow Style - Simple Domain (skill, uses a skill slot): passively activates while trapped in an enemy domain - a small barrier resists domain effects (including Unlimited Void's stun); you can move and use items, but cannot use techniques while it lasts. Costs 24 curse power/sec.
message.tinkersnewlife.skill.no_techniqu: §cTechniques are unavailable while Mikoshi Kago / Simple Domain is active
word.tinkersnewlife.ryomen.desc: Target: Ryomen Sukuna - his blaze sears the target and weakens it
word.tinkersnewlife.hastur.desc: Target: The King in Yellow - whispers blind and slow the target
word.tinkersnewlife.poison.desc: Core: Rot him - the target is poisoned
word.tinkersnewlife.explode.desc: Core: Detonate him - cursed blast at the target (no block damage)
word.tinkersnewlife.leech.desc: Core: Drain him - damage the target and heal half of it back
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.flavo: The court is in session; the guilty shall die.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.descr: Deploy the domain on a looked-at target: all creatures inside (except the caster) are frozen - New Shadow techniques are ineffective. The target becomes the defendant: undead are judged guilty after 3s (attack power zeroed for 60s); arthropods are guilty at night, innocent by day; players face a 6s trial (guilty if villager+animal kills exceed 1000). The guilty are executed by the Executioner's Sword (1 durability / 120s / unique): hitting the defendant kills it instantly, other creatures take 200% damage. Guilty players lose, in order, cursed tools -> techniques -> curse power for 60s (escalating each retrial). Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.open: §dExecution by Verdict - court is open! Defendant: %s
message.tinkersnewlife.fuzhu_cisi.death: Death sentence - carry it out now!
item.tinkersnewlife.execution_sword.desc: §c1 durability, vanishes after 120s. Striking the defendant kills it instantly; other creatures take 200% damage
modifier.tinkersnewlife.taizang_bianye.f: All things to one; all bear the weight.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.taizang_bianye.d: Domain expansion: every creature inside (except the caster) is crushed by pressure equal to 2x the Anti-Gravity reversal pressure (scales with curse affinity/output). Targets resist by body size & max HP: slow below threshold, crushed blocks / stun / sustained damage above it. This domain's pressure CAN be resisted by the New Shadow techniques (Mikoshi Kago / Falling Blossom / Simple Domain). Costs radius x30 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
True and false entwined; every art is mine.

Domain expansion: you enter a borrowed-technique state - switch freely among every technique you have unlocked in this save's Patchouli guide (switch key cycles the unlocked set; any unlocked technique can be cast instantly). Only while the domain is active: closing/leaving restores the technique selected before expansion. Costs radius x25 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.zhenyan.open: §dZhen Yan Xiang Ai - arts interlinked! %s techniques unlocked in this save - cycle with the switch key
modifier.tinkersnewlife.qianhe_yingyi.fl: Within the shadow court, ten thousand beasts arise.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.qianhe_yingyi.de: Domain expansion: forcibly stuns every target inside (except the caster - cannot move; New Shadow techniques CAN resist this domain's stun, like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Then summons ALL ten shadows shikigami x2 (all tamed, scaled by the caster's curse affinity/output) to hunt every target inside the domain. Closing the domain dismisses every summoned shikigami. Costs radius x60 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.qianhe.open: §dQian He Ying Yi Ting - ten thousand beasts arise! %s shikigami summoned
modifier.tinkersnewlife.tie_guan_gai_wei: The iron coffin topples; the mountain burns.

Domain expansion: every creature inside (except the caster) is kept on fire, and takes a curse-scorch hit every 5 ticks that ignores invulnerability frames (0.6 + output x0.35 + affinity x0.01 per hit; armor/resistance still applies). This domain CAN be resisted by the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Costs radius x50 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.tie_guan_gai_wei_: §cTie Guan Gai Wei Shan - the mountain burns! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.zi_bi_yuan_dun_g: Touch and transform; life reshaped by hand.

Domain expansion: each target inside (except the caster) is transfigured once - mobs are replaced by guardian shikigami of the chosen form (tamed, permanent); players are forcibly morphed for 60s (tools disabled). The form is the caster's Wu Wei selection if set (requires the Wu Wei technique); otherwise random zombie or skeleton. This domain CAN be resisted by the generic grace period and by the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Costs radius x60 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.zi_bi_yuan_dun_gu: §5Zi Bi Yuan Dun Guo - everyone transforms! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dang_yun_ping_xi: A single boat upon ten thousand waves.

Domain expansion: the interior floods with seawater - the caster cannot drown (same-team shikigami/spirits/guards get water breathing too; New Shadow techniques can resist this drowning hazard, like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable), while other creatures follow normal air rules. The domain keeps a swarm of drowned minions owned by the caster (6 + radius/2, up to 24): they actively hunt every non-allied target inside and attack in melee, refill automatically when killed, ~1/5 carry tridents. Closing the domain restores everything - water vanishes, drowned are dismissed. Costs radius x45 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.dang_yun_ping_xia: §bDang Yun Ping Xian - ten thousand waves! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.shi_bao_yue_gong: Moonlight freezes into time-cells; within one palace, every thought halts.

Domain expansion: moonlight freezes into time-cells - every target inside (except the caster) is hit by the same standstill stun as a failed Projection Technique (cannot move/attack/use items/turn the view; refreshed every 5 ticks until the domain ends). Players with the Heavenly Restriction - Tyrant body (curse-less pure physical power) are IMMUNE to this domain's stun - the moon's light cannot bind a body without curse. This domain CAN be resisted by the generic grace period and the New Shadow techniques (like Taizang Bianye - only Execution by Verdict is unstoppable). Closing the domain instantly releases everyone inside. Costs radius x55 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.shi_bao_yue_gong_: §dShi Bao Yue Gong Dian - all thoughts halt! Radius %s
Three calamities converge; nothing can be avoided.

Domain expansion (guaranteed-hit domain): every projectile the caster fires is steered each tick toward the nearest hostile target inside the domain - even a stray shot curves to hit. Empty left-clicks (swinging at air, at any distance) while holding a Construct technique temp item or a ranged weapon also land a guaranteed strike on the nearest hostile target inside (scaled by the player's attack damage). Targets: every living creature inside except the caster's own team. Costs radius x45 curse power per second. Uses a domain slot.
message.tinkersnewlife.san_chong_ji_ku.o: §6San Chong Ji Ku - nothing can be avoided! Radius %s
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yuchuzi.flavor: The stove-fire burns; the blade strikes like fate.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yuchuzi.descript: Technique Yu Chu Zi - combines Kai / Ba / Zao Kai into one technique (uses a technique slot). Press C to release the current move; press F (reverse key) to cycle Kai -> Ba -> Zao Kai: Kai = a single slash at a looked-at target (70% of the shared base, ignores i-frames, armor still applies); Ba = six slashes at a target within 3 blocks (each half of Kai's damage); Zao Kai = hold C to charge a flame arrow in your main hand, release to fire it (explodes on impact, 200% center damage falling with distance). Curse cost: Kai x1 / Ba x2 / Zao Kai x10 of the base.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blood_manipulati: Blood as a blade, piercing ten thousand foes.

Technique Blood Manipulation - combines Chuan Xue / Bai Lian / Supernova into one technique (uses a technique slot). Press C to release the current move; press F (reverse key) to cycle Chuan Xue -> Bai Lian -> Supernova: Chuan Xue = spend 5% max HP, fire a blood beam piercing 20 blocks, one hit per target of (1+affinity/100)x(output+blood x5); Bai Lian = spend 7% HP, lock a target by sight, five blood pillars dealing 5 hits (each = Chuan Xue single-target /2); Supernova = spend 10% HP, lock a target by sight, spawn a blood orb that explodes after 0.8s (center damage x blood x10, falling with distance). Ignores i-frames; armor still applies. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.corruption.descr: When dealing damage, spend 0.5% of your max soul energy (up to 100 per hit) to amplify the attack: every 5 souls add +0.2 attack damage and +0.05 blocks of knockback (knockback capped at 3 blocks). No effect when souls are insufficient.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_repair.desc: Every 20 ticks spend max(1, 6-level) soul energy to restore 1 durability; each restoration has a 5%×level chance to restore 1 additional durability. Max level 3. No effect when souls are insufficient.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.butcher.descript: While worn, all illagers (including witches) and villagers actively flee and never attack you, and you gain soul energy ×2.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.butcher.flavor: §7The butcher walks, and the wicked scatter.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dark_metal_break: Dealing damage inflicts Weakness I for 2×level seconds; slaying a creature with magic resistance (Resistance effect) has a 45% chance to drop 1 extra Emerald.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dark_metal_magic: When taking magic damage, convert 5%×level + 1.5 points of magic damage into physical damage.
item.tinkersnewlife.you_yun.desc: §7Base dmg 10, attack speed 2; every hit breaks shield blocking (like an axe), +120% fixed damage, +10% vs undead; extra knockback (dmg/100 blocks); cannot pierce Infinity.
item.tinkersnewlife.durandal_sword.descr: Legendary blade: unbreakable, extremely high attack, freely modifiable as a Tinkers' tool.
item.tinkersnewlife.silent_glove.descrip: Worn on the hand: automatically draws a weapon from your singularity storage while empty-handed.
item.tinkersnewlife.war_scythe.descripti: Each hit builds Fever, and attack speed scales with it. Spend Fever to blink; at full Fever unleash a finisher slash.
item.tinkersnewlife.flying_sword.descrip: Right-click to launch; it returns on hit. Toggle pursuit mode to hunt enemies automatically.
item.tinkersnewlife.modular_staff.descri: Adds bonus melee and spell/curse damage; casts as a true staff when Goety is installed.
item.tinkersnewlife.dragon_staff.descrip: Tames wild dragons at a heavy experience cost; its slots grow with level.
item.tinkersnewlife.yo_yo.description: A returning weapon that works both up close and at short range, with fast attacks for combos.
item.tinkersnewlife.curse_core.descripti: Determines curse energy cap, regeneration and domain radius; socket techniques / domains / skills into it.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_eater.flavo: §7Souls as food, the more you sip the richer.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_eater.descr: +25% soul energy gain per level; holding level 1 grants an extra +1 soul gain. Max level 3 (level 1 uses 1 upgrade slot; levels 2/3 are slotless).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.pale_plating.des: Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the tool 1 extra upgrade slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.commander.flavor: §7Command the rabble; strike the foe together.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.commander.descri: When you attack a non-illager target, every illager within 8 blocks has a 30% chance to switch its attack target to the one you are attacking.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.final_brand.flav: §7Sealed with the void, marked for the end.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.final_brand.desc: Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the tool 1 extra ability slot, but reduces movement speed by 10%.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blasphemy.flavor: §7Those who defile the gods are forsaken by them.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.blasphemy.descri: Slotless upgrade: installing costs no slots and grants the armor 2 extra defense slots, but increases damage taken by 10%.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ex_pierce.flavor: §7The might of five Outer Gods pierces all things.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ex_pierce.descri: Upgrade (costs 1 upgrade slot): melee/ranged hits are resolved as piercing damage — ignoring i-frames and piercing through invulnerabilities and damage caps (Wither spawn immunity and half-HP arrow immunity; with Cataclysm installed also its damage caps/out-of-water immunity/phase 2, Mowzie's Ferrous Wroughtnaut invulnerability, etc.).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.laevatain.tip: §cHits are true damage that pierces invulnerability/damage caps; applies anti-heal; chance to cut max HP; shatters pillars directly; sneak-right-click thrust; grants servants Resistance while held
modifier.tinkersnewlife.laevatain.flavor: §7The blazing brand that severs the sun light.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.laevatain.descri: Melee trait (Divine Gold melee head, mimics Valettein): hits become true damage ignoring damage reduction/invulnerability, apply a curse (anti-heal), chance to reduce the target's max HP; shatters the protecting pillars of Revelation limited bosses; grants nearby servants Resistance while held; kills do not trigger revival or health-lock.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.divine_power.tip: §6+180 mana; imbued spells: Fire Wall Lv5, Angel Wings Lv5, Healing Circle Lv10; Fire Wall ignores i-frames
modifier.tinkersnewlife.divine_power.des: Melee trait (Divine Gold melee head, Revelation×Iron's Spellbooks): grants the holder 180 extra max mana; the weapon carries imbued spells — Fire Wall 5, Angel Wings 5, Healing Circle 10; Fire Wall damage ignores i-frames.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.gungnir.tip: §bRanged projectile is a gravity-ignoring phantom (80% damage); on hit applies shock and ignites hellfire
modifier.tinkersnewlife.gungnir.flavor: §7Cast once, never missing — the oath-bound spear.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.gungnir.descript: Ranged trait (Divine Gold ranged weapon, mimics Gungnir): fired projectiles are gravity-ignoring phantoms dealing 80% of the projectile's damage; on hit applies shock and ignites hellfire at the target's feet (direct hits deal more).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.godrealm_overste: §dImmune to explosion, fire and magic damage
Armor trait (Divine Gold armor): immune to explosion, fire and magic damage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.heaven_earth_for: Armor trait (Divine Gold armor): each durability loss does not exceed 20.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_discount.ti: §e5% soul energy cost reduction per level
modifier.tinkersnewlife.soul_discount.de: Armor trait (Divine Gold armor): 5% soul energy cost reduction per level.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_adrenalin: §7Between life and death, cursed blood surges.
When the wearer takes hostile or fall damage, spend 10 soul energy to gain 5 seconds of Swiftness II (equivalent speed bonus, no FOV change); cooldown 1 minute.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_bird.descr: Activate to spawn a black bird (bat) at your position and take control of it: W flies along your look, A/D strafe, Space ascends; press Shift to dive and self-destruct (no block damage; center damage = (1 + affinity/100) x (output x 3 + bat health) x 10, radius 2). Press the release key again to recall it and refund half the curse energy; the view returns when the bird dies. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_bird.flavo: §7Black wings carry your sight beyond the body.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_flash.desc: Each hit has a 0.01% chance to land a Black Flash, dealing damage to the power of 2.5; for 60s after it triggers the chance rises by 10% and speed, attack and jump are boosted by 20%.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.black_flash.flav: §7For one instant, the world is one step late.
Each hit builds Fever, and attack speed scales with it; hold a direction key while attacking to spend 20 Fever and blink; at full Fever, hold W + Shift + right-click to unleash a finisher slash.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.charm.descriptio: Hitting a creature charms it; while charmed it cannot attack you. 30 second cooldown.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.charm.flavor: §7A glance, and the will is no longer its own.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.child_of_the_sta: Doubles the final damage you deal (doubles again per level).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.construct.descri: Forward (technique key C): toggles Infinite Ammo mode - while holding a weapon that draws ammo from your inventory (vanilla bows/crossbows, Tinkers bows, TACZ guns, etc.), running dry spends curse energy to conjure the matching arrow/bullet. Reverse (reverse key F): opens the construct inventory; pick any item that has a crafting recipe - its curse energy cost is computed from its value and power and deducted at once, then construction begins. 1 curse energy = 1 tick of build time; you move slower and cannot reverse again while working, and being hit interrupts it without refunding the energy. On completion you receive a temporary item that fades after 60 seconds. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.construct.flavor: §7Nothing comes from nothing - only from will.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cosmic_order_voi: Hits apply Slowness and Blindness to the target, with duration increasing per level.
§7The spheres speak, and the small things stumble.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_output.des: Determines your curse domain radius (5 blocks per level), curse energy cap and regeneration.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_output.fla: §7How loudly the curse answers your call.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_total.desc: Curse energy cap = Curse Total level x (Curse Output level + curse affinity/10) x 500.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.curse_total.flav: §7A well deep enough to drown in.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_energy_re: Forward: fire a bolt of pure curse energy along your look, dealing heavy damage on impact. Reverse: Granite Blast - curse energy pours out as a continuous laser, dealing i-frame-ignoring damage every 2 ticks for 3 seconds, steerable by turning your view; afterwards forward and reverse share a 6 second cooldown. Unaffected by technique burnout.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_speech.de: Forward (technique key C): chant your current curse speech - a six-part line of exclamation, honorific plus target, prayer plus core meaning, and closing thanks. Chanting takes time and is interrupted by hits without refunding; after release the backlash is calculated from the target's health and your output/affinity. Reverse (reverse key F): opens the curse speech editor. Words are learned from Ancient Cursed Scrolls, found randomly in loot chests. Exclamation gives curse energy cost, honorific gives effect strength, prayer gives duration, closing thanks reduces backlash. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_speech.fl: §7Words the world is obliged to answer.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_spirit.de: Forward: when a cursed spirit within sight drops to 2.5% health or less, record that individual into the GUI (full NBT) and make it disperse (instantly ending boss fights); the cost depends on its max health plus your output and affinity, and you gain 30s Hunger and 10s Nausea. Otherwise it opens the individual list (scroll bar + 3D display): click to release a full-health individual (it serves you and only attacks what threatens you or what you attack), click a released one again to recall it; if a released individual dies its record is lost. Reverse (F): choose an unreleased individual as a sacrifice, charge a black vortex, then press F again to fire it along your look (damage scales with its health/attack and your output/affinity). Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.cursed_spirit.fl: §7The dead stay loyal, if you hold the leash.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragon_blood_inf: Spends dragon blood to apply effects to enemies: fire dragon blood ignites, ice dragon blood frosts, lightning dragon blood disarms.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragon_blood_tan: +5000 mB capacity per level, up to 25000 mB; stores all three dragon bloods.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragon_staff.des: Tames wild dragons at a heavy experience cost; its slots grow with level.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragon_staff.fla: §7Raise your hand, and the sky lowers its head.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragonbone.descr: Raises the level of Dragonsteel trait effects by one.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragonbone.flavo: §7Bones that can carry a dragon's weight.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragonsteel_fire: Hits cause a small explosion, igniting the target and nearby enemies; burn duration increases per level.
§7Fire that was never born of wood.
While worn grants Fire Resistance, and ignites attackers when you are hit.
Hits apply frost, greatly slowing the target, dealing continuous freezing damage and spreading frost around them.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragonsteel_ice_: While worn grants immunity to powder snow and freezing damage, and freezes attackers when you are hit.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dragonsteel_ligh: Hits call down lightning, dealing damage and disarming the target for 3 seconds.
§7The sky answers before the question is asked.
While worn grants Night Vision and Resistance; when attacked, lightning strikes back and disarms the attacker.
§7Scales that strike before they are struck.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dreadsteel.descr: Each swing releases a wide sword beam that pierces enemies ignoring armor, and hits apply Weakness, Blindness and Wither.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dreadsteel.flavo: §7A blade that cuts past every wall of steel.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.dreadsteel_armor: While worn grants Night Vision, Fire Resistance, frost immunity and damage limiting (at most 30 per 0.5s). Press the bound key and spend 5 experience levels to unfold the Dread Domain: for 5 seconds it repeatedly damages creatures within 16 blocks where the light level is below 8. 120 second cooldown.
§7Armor woven from the thing that frightens the dark.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.flame_manipulati: Forward: melt the 3x3 blocks under a target in your sight (bedrock excepted) into blazing magma - a temporary pool that reverts after 3 seconds; anything standing in it takes continuous curse damage and is set alight. Reverse (key F): spend ceil(M x 100) to summon five 1/8-size phantoms with 1 health that self-destruct, waiting 1 second then ramming enemies in turn; each explosion equals the black bird's (radius 3), sets enemies alight and lights a 3x3 fire at their feet. Uses a technique slot.
§7Where it walks, the ground remembers being molten.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.flying_sword.des: Right-click to launch the sword; it returns after hitting. Toggle pursuit mode to hunt enemies automatically.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.flying_sword.fla: §7The blade that comes back on its own.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fumo_yuchuzi.des: Press the key to unfold the domain: every 2 ticks it releases slashes at all creatures and players inside except the caster, with sweep particle effects, ignoring i-frames and leaving redstone-dust blood on the ground (breaking it drops nothing). Each slash deals (1 + (Curse Output level + curse affinity/10)/10) x (current attack damage + Curse Output level x 5) x 5%, and can be reduced or even negated by armor, shields and other defenses. Drains radius x 40 curse energy per second (twice Zuo Sha Bo Tu).
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fumo_yuchuzi.fla: §7A kitchen that must serve every guest at once.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.fus_ro_dah.descr: Hits launch the target away; the higher the level, the stronger the push.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ghost_clearing.f: §7Seeing is not believing - it is dismissing.
While worn, immune to the gorgon's petrifying gaze.
§7Do not look with eyes that can turn to stone.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.hastur_malice.de: Attacks create a wind field that pulls nearby creatures in and deals continuous damage to everything inside.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jacobs_ladder.de: Against the target you look at, summon a great magic circle bearing a seven-pointed star and a cross 10 blocks above its head; after 2 seconds of charging a huge pillar of light descends. Struck targets are locked out of techniques and domains for 60 seconds (any ongoing curse technique ends instantly) and take continuous frame damage (once every 2 ticks, ignoring i-frames), with undead taking x8. Circle radius = (1 + (affinity/10 + output)/10) x output x 5; frame damage = (1 + (affinity/10 + output)/10) x (output x 8 + player damage) x 0.1. Costs 8 times the curse energy of Kai. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.jacobs_ladder.fl: §7A stair lowered from the sky, for judgement alone.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.lightning_manipu: Forward: strike a target in your sight with lightning (purely visual - it does not use vanilla lightning damage or conversion); the damage is dealt as curse damage (80% of your damage basis). Reverse (key F): technique release Beast Amber - while active every melee/ranged hit carries bonus curse lightning (+round((1 + affinity/100) x (5 + output x 5))), but each tick drains ceil(max(1, (1 - affinity/100) x (2 + output))) curse energy and (0.15 + output x 0.05) health, ending automatically when either runs out; press again to switch it off. Uses a technique slot.
§7Borrow a sky that never belonged to you.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.lucky_drop.descr: Killing a creature has a 50% chance to roll loot an extra time, and raises Ice and Fire rare drop chances to 50%.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.lucky_drop.flavo: §7The dead keep giving, if you ask twice.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.modular_staff.de: Adds +1.5 melee damage; spells and curse techniques (Kai / Ba / Zao Kai) gain bonus damage and increased power.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.nyarlathotep_des: Grants 1 extra ability slot per level, up to level 5.
§7A gift that asks for more each time.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.plant_manipulati: Forward: press the release key to open a selection screen (Roots / Curse Seed), then charge, aim at an enemy and press again to release. Roots grow a sweet berry bush under the target (2 seconds to full growth without fruiting, lasting 3 seconds, slowing and dealing curse damage - and it cannot be broken or destroyed, dropping nothing). Curse Seed inflicts parasitism on the target (attack -40%, Curse Total/Output -1 level, affinity -60). Reverse (key F): absorb plants within a 5x5x5 area around you and convert them into curse energy (grass block to dirt +1; grass/flower/sapling +3; leaves +8). Uses a technique slot.
§7Green things listen, if you speak their language.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.projection.descr: Activate to spawn a phantom of yourself along your look on the same horizontal plane (distance = 2/3 to 1 times your maximum straight-line movement in 1 second). Touching the phantom within 1 second grants a 10 second buff: damage, jump and speed x2. Costs 1/12 of your curse energy cap. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.projection.flavo: §7Step where you are not, and be there.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.puppet.descripti: Activate to summon an iron or snow golem in front of you (chosen in the GUI) and transfer your view into it: the iron golem attacks with left-click, launches with right-click and self-destructs with Shift (radius 5, no block damage); the snow golem throws snowballs with right-click (frost on hit) and self-destructs with Shift (radius 3, with frost). Press the release key again to recall it and refund 30% of the curse energy; your view returns when the puppet dies. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.puppet.flavor: §7Borrow a body that does not fear breaking.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.quantum_bag.desc: Stores items in a pocket of your own personal dimension.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.reverse_cursed.d: Press the technique key (C) to cast Reverse Cursed Technique on yourself - spend Curse Output x 10 curse energy to restore (1 + (affinity/10 + output)/10) x output x 2 health. Press the reverse key (F) to cast it outward: it heals the target; if the target is undead it instead takes damage equal to twice the amount that would have been healed. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.reverse_cursed.f: §7To unmake the wound by unmaking the harm.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.silent_glove.des: While empty-handed, automatically draws a weapon from your singularity storage.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.silent_glove.fla: §7The hand that never needs to reach.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.sky_manipulation: Forward: if a hostile target is in your sight, launch and push it along your look (pure displacement); with no target, give yourself a push along your look (a dash or a leap). Reverse (key F): fire a Usoroton at the target you have locked onto - on hit it shatters space like thin ice, blasting the opponent away and dealing curse damage (the hit carries your core material traits). Push, damage and cost all scale with curse affinity and output. Uses a technique slot.
§7The sky is a surface, if you stand on it correctly.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.star_child_armor: While worn, kills increase your max health; each armor piece stores its own kill count, and once one is full the count carries over to the next piece.
§7Every death adds a little more sky to you.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_shadows.desc: Press the technique release key to open the shikigami selection screen: summoning a shikigami costs curse energy (upkeep is free), and its size, speed and base stats scale with your curse affinity and Curse Output. Only Divine Dog is available at first; the other nine must be tamed - the first time you summon an untamed shikigami it attacks both you and your locked target, and defeating it tames it. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.ten_shadows.flav: §7Ten shadows, and only one of them is yours yet.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.west_tiger.descr: When applied to a Black Flash weapon, its base Black Flash trigger chance is increased by your current attack damage divided by 10000.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.west_tiger.flavo: §7The tiger that waits at the western gate.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wu_wei.descripti: Press P to open the form selection screen (killing a creature records its form). Press the technique key (C) for the forward mode: transform yourself into the chosen creature, inheriting all of its base attributes but none of its abilities or AI, with your view transferred into it; press C again to return to human form. Press the reverse key (F) to toggle Transmutation Outward: the next attack transforms the target (creature or player) into the chosen creature - creature targets are changed permanently and become guardian shikigami (death is then true death), while player targets revert automatically after 60 seconds and cannot use tools meanwhile. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wu_wei.flavor: §7Change the shape, and the life follows.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wuliang_cang.des: Press the technique key (C) to begin charging Blue; press again to fire a sky-blue orb forward that drags entities within 10 blocks toward its center (the caster excepted), exploding when an entity touches the center. Press the reverse key (F) to fire Blue's reversal, Red: a bright red orb that pushes entities away - ones pushed into blocks take damage based on their speed, and touching its center explodes for twice Blue's damage. Press F while Blue is charging to combine them into Hollow Technique: Purple and fire it directly, destroying every block it touches (bedrock excepted, no drops) and dealing ten times Blue's explosion damage to entities hit. All three orbs travel at most 40 blocks; Blue and Red vanish when they hit blocks. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wuliang_cang.fla: §7Attraction, repulsion, and the hollow between them.
Press the key to unfold the domain: every creature and player except the opener is frozen in place (unable to attack, move, use items, switch hotbar slots or open their inventory) while still affected by physics; when it closes, the stun continues for (time inside/10 + Curse Output level) x (1 + curse affinity/100) x 10 ticks. Drains radius x 80 curse energy per second (four times Zuo Sha Bo Tu). Creatures resist by health and players by curse affinity.
§7Infinite information, and no way to think it.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.wuliang_wuxian.d: Press the technique release key (C) to switch it on and press again to switch it off (a toggle that persists across technique changes). While active, damage below the threshold is negated; damage above it spends curse energy per point of overflow, and when the energy runs out it switches off automatically and you take one shield-break hit (overflow x 5). Threshold = (1 + (affinity/10 + output)/10) x 10. Uses a technique slot.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.yog_sothoth_gift: While holding this tool, experience gained is increased by 500%.
§7Time is a currency, and the gate pays generously.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.zuosha_botu.desc: Press the key to unfold the domain and lock enemies in: it drains radius x 20 curse energy per second and closes automatically when empty. Every 3 seconds the domain draws a prize (70% small / 29% large / 1% grand; after 10 misses in a row the 11th is guaranteed grand). Small: +250 curse energy and 10 seconds of Absorption IV. Large: +900 curse energy and 30 seconds of Regeneration. Grand: unlimited curse energy for 33 seconds, health locked to its maximum, and +100 curse affinity.
modifier.tinkersnewlife.zuosha_botu.flav: §7Sit, kill, and let the dice decide.
